Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

useful adjective

also handy, of use, be useful, come in handy, usefulness, helpful (of a thing), practical (handy), functional (practical, made for use), functional

classical

Phaedr. 4.13.1: ūtilius hominī nihil est quam rēctē loquī
Mart. 14.144.1–2: tergendīs spongia mēnsīs ūtilis

ūtilis, ūtile

adjective, third declension; with the dative or ad

useful, of use, good for

What it is useful for goes in the dative (tergendīs mēnsīs, for wiping tables) or with ad. The opposite is inūtilis.

Other words

  • ūsuī esse — to be useful, to come in handy

    phrase: ūsus in the dative of purpose, often with magnō, and a dative of the person · classical · Cic. Att. 1.1.3: fuit et mihi et Quīntō frātrī magnō ūsuī (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 5.1: ea quae sunt ūsuī ad armandās nāvēs (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • sum cocleīs habilis, sed nec minus ūtilis ōvīs. numquid scīs, potius cūr cocleāre vocer?

    I am handy for snails, but no less useful for eggs. Do you know why I am called after the snail rather than the egg?Mart. 14.121

  • nisi ūtile est quod facimus, stulta est glōria

    unless what we do is useful, the glory is foolishPhaedr. 3.17.12

  • Hoc tibi ūsuī erit.

    This will come in handy for you.composed

See also help, tool.
